# GSE100 source evidence

Complete public GEO family XML, retrieved 2026-09-10 from
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSEnnn/GSE100/miniml/GSE100_family.xml.tgz.
No samples or channels removed. SHA-256 of inputs/geo.xml:
6696a5e9b9965f935089299b817dbb27fb06469e7e1d4ce78c2cc2ffc0516caa.

GPL221 Technology is `spotted DNA/cDNA`. Four samples each supply two channels.
The converter regression disables external enrichment, replays real GEO retrieval,
and checks automatic versus explicit array output, assay nodes and GPL221.
